segments.normalizedSource: ```swift /// Apply dilation to the red channel. group.addTask(priority: .userInitiated) { [self] in sourceRedBuffer.applyMorphology(operation: .dilate(structuringElement: bokeh), destination: destinationRedBuffer) } /// Apply dilation to the green channel. group.addTask(priority: .userInitiated) { [self] in sourceGreenBuffer.applyMorphology(operation: .dilate(structuringElement: bokeh), destination: destinationGreenBuffer) } /// Apply dilation to the blue channel. group.addTask(priority: .userInitiated) { [self] in sourceBlueBuffer.applyMorphology(operation: .dilate(structuringElement: bokeh), destination: destinationBlueBuffer) } ```
